description:
Tarot readings in ChatGPT, drawn from a full illustrated 78-card deck.

Ask a question, tap the card and watch it turn over, then read what the cards say: a few clear sentences for each card, with its full meaning one tap away.

What you get
• Your tarot card of the day: one card that stays yours all day, and a new one tomorrow
• Yes or No tarot: one card and a clear yes, no or maybe for your question
• Love tarot: three cards for you, your partner and the connection between you
• Past, Present and Future: a three-card timeline read against your question, with love, career and money questions read on their own terms
• A short meaning, keywords and advice for every card, and the card's full guide on theastroscope.com
• Cards that float, lean toward your finger and turn over when you tap them
• Three-card readings open full screen with every card's advice and keywords
• Every result suggests the next reading: yes or no, love, or past, present and future
• Ask a follow-up question about your cards right in the chat
• English and Spanish

Come back for
• A new card of the day every morning: one tap asks ChatGPT for your card each morning
• A fresh reading whenever a new question is on your mind

Try asking
• "Draw my tarot card of the day"
• "Yes or no tarot: should I take the new job offer?"
• "3-card love tarot reading: where is my relationship going?"
• "Past, present and future tarot: how will my career change this year?"

Your data
No account is needed. Your question is used to read the cards and is added to the link that opens the same reading on theastroscope.com.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
